requirements.text: Minimum Qualification(s): - Currently pursuing an Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline. - Able to commit to a 12-week internship during Summer 2027. - Proficient coding skills and strong algorithm & data structure basis. - Effective communication and teamwork skills. Preferred Qualifications: - Currently pursuing an Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline. - Agentic Frameworks: Exposure to or strong interest in LLM orchestration, custom agent architectures, or API-driven automation.
